title: 1000 Islands Water Tours
specs: Visit Boldt Castle, Singer Castle, Rock Island Lighthouse, and more
See historical shipwrecks including A. E. Vickery and Roy A. Jodrey
Wildlife includes bald eagles, common terns, and various mammals
All captains are USCG Masters with 100 ton licenses
Small private tours up to 6 guests per trip
blurb: Guests take small private boat tours up to 6 guests per trip, choosing their own itinerary among sites like Boldt Castle, Singer Castle, Rock Island Lighthouse, and more. The tours explore historical shipwrecks, wildlife, and scenic islands on the St. Lawrence River. The operator has two boats and captains with USCG 100 ton licenses and extensive local knowledge.
extraNote: Park admission to Keewaydin State Park is $6.00 · Marina at Keewaydin State Park in Alexandria Bay
